title: Sinking of the Nossa Senhora da Conceição
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Sinking of the Nossa Senhora da Conceição", at revision 1370747127, opens: "The sinking of the Nossa Senhora da Conceição was a naval engagement between the loaded Portuguese carrack, commanded by Luís de Sousa, and a fleet of Algerian corsairs in 1621. Severely outnumbered and heavily damaged after days of battle, the ship was engulfed in flames and sank with its rich cargo." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q132175198, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1621 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
